variants.title: Time constant of an RL circuit
variants.sample: RL circuit: unknown coil in series with a resistance box
variants.method: Square wave and oscilloscope, voltage across R
variants.aim: Apply a square wave to a resistance and a coil in series, watch the voltage across the resistance on an oscilloscope and measure the time the current takes to reach 63.2 % of its final value.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)
